# truenas_directoryservices (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS directory services configuration (directoryservices.config) and health (directoryservices.status). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one directory services configuration per TrueNAS system. Does not expose "credential": see the truenas_directoryservices resource documentation for why the credential used to join a domain is never readable back from TrueNAS.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `configuration_activedirectory` (Attributes) Active Directory join configuration, or null if not configured for Active Directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory))
- `configuration_ipa` (Attributes) IPA (FreeIPA) join configuration, or null if not configured for IPA. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_ipa))
- `configuration_ldap` (Attributes) Plain LDAP directory configuration, or null if not configured for LDAP. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_ldap))
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether directory services are currently enabled.
- `enable_account_cache` (Boolean) Whether backend caching for user and group lists is enabled.
- `enable_dns_updates` (Boolean) Whether automatic DNS updates via nsupdate/GSSAPI/TSIG are enabled.
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "directoryservices".
- `kerberos_realm` (String) Name of the Kerberos realm used for authentication to the directory service.
- `service_type` (String) The directory service type currently configured, or null if never joined.
- `status` (String) Directory service status from the last health check: DISABLED, FAULTED, LEAVING, JOINING, or HEALTHY. Null if directory services are disabled.
- `status_msg` (String) Reason the directory service is FAULTED after a failed health check. Null if not faulted.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout (in seconds) for DNS queries and LDAP network requests.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_activedirectory`

Read-Only:

- `computer_account_ou` (String) Organizational unit (OU) containing the TrueNAS computer account.
- `domain` (String) Full DNS domain name of the joined Active Directory domain.
- `enable_trusted_domains` (Boolean) Whether support for trusted domains is enabled.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the TrueNAS server registered in Active Directory.
- `idmap` (Attributes) Active Directory idmap configuration (UID/GID mapping), or null if not configured for Active Directory. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap))
- `site` (String) The Active Directory site where the TrueNAS server is located.
- `use_default_domain` (Boolean) Whether the domain prefix is removed from Active Directory user/group names.

<a id="nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_activedirectory.idmap`

Read-Only:

- `builtin` (Attributes) UID/GID range for automatically generated well-known/BUILTIN accounts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap--builtin))
- `idmap_domain` (Attributes) How domain accounts joined to TrueNAS are mapped to Unix UIDs/GIDs. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap--idmap_domain))

<a id="nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap--builtin"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_activedirectory.idmap.builtin`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Short name for the domain.
- `range_high` (Number) Highest UID/GID the idmap backend can assign.
- `range_low` (Number) Lowest UID/GID the idmap backend can assign.


<a id="nestedatt--configuration_activedirectory--idmap--idmap_domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_activedirectory.idmap.idmap_domain`

Read-Only:

- `idmap_backend` (String) Idmap backend type ("AD" or "RID" for this provider version).
- `name` (String) Short name for the domain.
- `range_high` (Number) Highest UID/GID the idmap backend can assign.
- `range_low` (Number) Lowest UID/GID the idmap backend can assign.
- `schema_mode` (String) AD backend schema mode.
- `sssd_compat` (Boolean) RID backend only: SSSD-compatible low range.
- `unix_nss_info` (Boolean) AD backend only: shell/home directory source.
- `unix_primary_group` (Boolean) AD backend only: primary group source.




<a id="nestedatt--configuration_ipa"></a>
### Nested Schema for `configuration_ipa`

Read-Only:

- `basedn` (String) The base DN used for LDAP operations.
- `domain` (String) The domain of the IPA server.
- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the TrueNAS server registered in IPA.
